title: Food and how you feel in one diary
description: Save dishes, symptoms and your own notes, and before an appointment gather the history for a chosen period.

blocks.text: A reviewer uses the history of entries at an appointment with a gastroenterologist. What helps here is not a general calorie calculation but the ability to recall particular events over the period that matters.

quote.text: I’ve been using this app for 4 years. It’s super easy to use, it’s convenient to scroll through BM history, and I absolutely love having the 7-day average for telling my GI at appointments.

blocks.text: Save the time of a meal, the symptoms and personal explanations as separate entries. Before the appointment, choose a period and look through what will go into the selection. Keep access to the particular episodes behind any summary.
Don’t turn a coincidence into a diagnosis
The app helps you not forget observations and questions. An automatic list of “guilty” foods would call for different grounds; a diary alone does not provide them.
